format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

We are measuring how immigration attitudes of voters are affected by exposure to Spanish on a train, which can be affected  by age, and education and as well. The data source is the 2 week Enos survey, studying causal effect of Spanish exposure on immigration attitudes.

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(primer.data)
trains
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

ggplot(trains, aes(x = treatment, y = att_end)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", color = "red", size = 3, shape = 18) +
  labs(
    title = "Attitude End Scores by Treatment Group",
    subtitle = "Individual observations with the group mean highlighted",
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Attitude End Score",
    caption = "Each point represents one observation; the red point shows the group mean."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
glimpse(trains)
```
